title: Personal Credit Cards: Balance Transfer Availability, Introductory Rate and Fee
content:
This quick reference states, for each tier of Personal Credit Cards, whether a balance from another lender may be moved onto the card, whether an introductory rate is offered on such transfers, how long that rate lasts and within what opening window a transfer must post to earn it, and the fee charged on each transfer.

| Tier | Transfers accepted | Introductory transfer APR | Statement cycles the introductory APR runs after opening | Calendar days after opening within which a transfer must post for the introductory APR | Transfer fee, percent of each transfer | Smallest fee per transfer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | no | not offered | not offered | not offered | not applicable | not applicable |
| College Rewards Visa | no | not offered | not offered | not offered | not applicable | not applicable |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | yes | 0.00 percent | 18 | 60 | 3.00 percent | 5.00 USD |
| Cash Rewards Visa | yes | 0.00 percent | 15 | 60 | 3.00 percent | 5.00 USD |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | yes | not offered | not offered | not offered | 5.00 percent | 5.00 USD |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | yes | not offered | not offered | not offered | 5.00 percent | 5.00 USD |

## Points of judgement

- On Secured Visa and College Rewards Visa no transfer is accepted, so neither a transfer fee nor an introductory rate can arise.
- Travel Rewards Visa Signature and Visa Infinite Private Client accept transfers but never at an introductory rate.
- The percentage fee and the smallest fee are read together: the fee is whichever of the two is larger.

> Worked example with hypothetical figures: a 120.00 USD transfer onto a Platinum Low Rate Visa card gives 3.00 percent of 120.00 USD, which is 3.60 USD; as that is less than the 5.00 USD smallest fee, the fee billed is 5.00 USD. A 900.00 USD transfer gives 27.00 USD, which exceeds 5.00 USD, so 27.00 USD is billed.
